blocks.text: CAGAYAN DE ORO CITY — After decades on the frontlines against insurgency, 78 members of the Civilian Armed Forces Geographical Unit (CAFGU) Active Auxiliary (CAA) of the Army’s 10th Infantry Division (10ID) traded their active duty status for reserve roles, receiving separation gratuity pay in a first-of-its-kind ceremony in Davao de Oro. In a statement on Monday, Maj. Ruben Gadut, 10ID spokesperson, said the division formally honored the retired CAFGU personnel — five of whom had served for 38 years — at Camp General Manuel T.
